Q01_volumetrie.sql: SELECT event, count(*) AS n, min(ts) AS debut_utc,max(ts) AS fin_utc FROM events GROUP BY event;

Q02_qualite_import.sql: SELECT kind,count(*) AS n FROM audit GROUP BY kind;

Q03_classes.sql: SELECT cause,count(*) AS n,count(DISTINCT client_id) AS clients,count(DISTINCT server_id) AS parties,min(ts) AS debut_utc,max(ts) AS fin_utc FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike' GROUP BY cause ORDER BY n DESC;

Q04_build.sql: SELECT build,count(*) AS rapports,sum(cause='overlay') AS overlay,sum(cause='inconsistent') AS incoherents,round(avg(CASE WHEN cause NOT IN ('inconsistent','background','shader') THEN frame_ms END),1) AS moyenne_filtre_ms,min(ts) AS debut_utc,max(ts) AS fin_utc FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike' GROUP BY build;

Q05_cohortes.sql: SELECT build,width>=2560 AS haute_definition,bloom,count(*) AS rapports,sum(cause='overlay') AS overlay FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike' AND cause<>'inconsistent' GROUP BY build,haute_definition,bloom;

Q06_overlay_population.sql: SELECT browser,width,bloom,count(*) AS n,count(DISTINCT client_id) AS clients FROM events WHERE cause='overlay' GROUP BY browser,width,bloom ORDER BY n DESC;

Q07_tick_horaire.sql: SELECT substr(local_time,1,13) AS heure_paris,count(*) AS n,round(avg(tick_gap_ms),1) AS tick_gap_moyen FROM events WHERE tick_gap_ms>=150 GROUP BY heure_paris;

Q08_farming.sql: SELECT substr(local_time,1,10) AS jour,count(*) AS parties,sum(short_win) AS victoires_courtes,sum(quarantined) AS quarantaines,round(min(duration_s),2) AS min_s,round(max(duration_s),2) AS max_s FROM events WHERE event='game_completed' GROUP BY jour;

Q09_farming_intervalles.sql: SELECT ts,server_id,round(duration_s,2) AS secondes,quarantined,round((julianday(ts)-julianday(lag(ts) OVER(ORDER BY ts)))*86400,1) AS intervalle_s FROM events WHERE short_win=1 ORDER BY ts;

Q10_incoherences.sql: SELECT client_id,count(*) AS n,min(ts) AS debut_utc,max(ts) AS fin_utc,min(frame_ms) AS frame_min,max(frame_ms) AS frame_max,min(total_ms) AS total_min,max(total_ms) AS total_max FROM events WHERE cause='inconsistent' GROUP BY client_id;

Q11_trous.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT ts,lag(ts) OVER(ORDER BY ts) AS precedent FROM events) SELECT precedent,ts,round((julianday(ts)-julianday(precedent))*86400,1) AS secondes FROM t WHERE (julianday(ts)-julianday(precedent))*86400>1800 ORDER BY secondes DESC;

Q12_schemas.sql: SELECT version,count(*) AS n,sum(rtt_ms IS NULL) AS rtt_absent,sum(json_extract(raw,'$.report.graphics.gpuRenderMs') IS NULL) AS gpu_absent FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike' GROUP BY version;

Q13_temps_incoherents.sql: SELECT event,sum(duration_s<0) AS avant_creation,sum(duration_s>86400) AS plus_un_jour,sum(json_extract(raw,'$.server.players')+json_extract(raw,'$.server.bots')>json_extract(raw,'$.server.capacity')) AS capacite_depassee FROM events GROUP BY event;

Q14_clients_sequences.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT client_id,cast(substr(report_id,12) AS INTEGER) AS seq FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike'), d AS(SELECT DISTINCT client_id,seq FROM s), g AS(SELECT client_id,seq-lag(seq) OVER(PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY seq)-1 AS manque FROM d) SELECT client_id,sum(manque) AS numeros_non_observes FROM g WHERE manque>0 GROUP BY client_id ORDER BY numeros_non_observes DESC;

Q15_parties_sans_fin.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.server_id) AS parties_sans_fin FROM events p WHERE p.event='perf_spike' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events g WHERE g.event='game_completed' AND g.server_id=p.server_id);

Q16_avant_apres_cohorte.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ts<'2026-09-24T16:00:00.000Z' THEN 'avant_jeudi_18h_Paris' ELSE 'apres' END AS periode,count(*) AS rapports,sum(cause='overlay') AS overlay,count(DISTINCT client_id) AS clients FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike' AND width>=2560 AND bloom=1 AND cause<>'inconsistent' GROUP BY periode;

Q17_premiers_overlay.sql: SELECT ts,local_time,build,client_id,frame_ms,overlay_ms,rtt_ms,tick_gap_ms FROM events WHERE cause='overlay' ORDER BY ts LIMIT 10;

Q18_farming_signature.sql: SELECT map,json_extract(raw,'$.server.score') AS score,count(*) AS n,round(min(duration_s),1) AS min_s,round(max(duration_s),1) AS max_s,sum(quarantined) AS quarantaines,min(ts) AS debut,max(ts) AS fin FROM events WHERE event='game_completed' GROUP BY map,score,short_win ORDER BY n DESC;

Q19_temoin_tick.sql: SELECT cause,tick_gap_ms>=150 AS tick_degrade,count(*) AS n,round(avg(rtt_ms),1) AS rtt_moyen,round(avg(frame_ms),1) AS frame_moyen FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike' GROUP BY cause,tick_degrade;

Q20_fps_pas_inverse.sql: SELECT cause,count(*) AS n,sum(abs(json_extract(raw,'$.report.fps')-1000.0/frame_ms)>5) AS fps_non_inverses FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike' GROUP BY cause;

Q21_resume_anomalies.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rapports,sum(total_ms>frame_ms+10) AS travail_sup_frame,sum(json_extract(raw,'$.report.fps')>144) AS fps_sup_144,sum(json_extract(raw,'$.report.graphics.gpuTimerSupported')=0 AND json_extract(raw,'$.report.graphics.gpuRenderMs') IS NOT NULL) AS gpu_contradictoire FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike';

Q22_jours.sql: SELECT substr(local_time,1,10) AS jour,event,count(*) AS n FROM events GROUP BY jour,event;

Q23_deploiement_cohorte.sql: SELECT build,count(*) AS rapports,sum(cause='overlay') AS overlay,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cause='overlay' THEN client_id END) AS clients_overlay,min(ts) AS premier_rapport FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike' AND cause<>'inconsistent' AND width>=2560 AND bloom=1 GROUP BY build;

Q24_controle_hors_cohorte.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ts<'2026-09-24T16:00:00.000Z' THEN 'avant' ELSE 'apres' END AS periode,count(*) AS rapports,sum(cause='overlay') AS overlay FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike' AND cause<>'inconsistent' AND NOT(width>=2560 AND bloom=1) GROUP BY periode;

Q25_farming_clients.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rapports,count(DISTINCT p.client_id) AS clients FROM events p JOIN events g ON p.server_id=g.server_id AND g.short_win=1 WHERE p.event='perf_spike';

Q26_ordre_source.sql: WITH t AS(SELECT ts,lag(ts) OVER(ORDER BY source_index) AS precedent FROM events) SELECT sum(ts>precedent) AS remontees,sum(ts<precedent) AS descentes,sum(ts=precedent) AS egalites FROM t;

Q27_parts_sans_fin_par_cause.sql: SELECT p.cause,count(DISTINCT p.server_id) AS parties FROM events p WHERE p.event='perf_spike' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events g WHERE g.event='game_completed' AND g.server_id=p.server_id) GROUP BY p.cause;

Q28_apres_fin.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rapports_apres_fin FROM events p JOIN events g ON g.event='game_completed' AND p.server_id=g.server_id WHERE p.event='perf_spike' AND p.ts>g.ts;

Q29_phase_build.sql: SELECT build,cause,count(*) AS n FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike' AND phase<>'play' GROUP BY build,cause;

Q30_seuils.sql: SELECT cause,min(overlay_ms) AS overlay_min,max(overlay_ms) AS overlay_max,min(frame_ms) AS frame_min,max(frame_ms) AS frame_max,round(avg(frame_ms),1) AS moyenne,round(avg(overlay_ms),1) AS overlay_moyen FROM events WHERE event='perf_spike' GROUP BY cause;

Q31_overlay_cohorte_detail.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n,count(DISTINCT client_id) AS clients,count(DISTINCT server_id) AS parties,min(ts) AS debut,max(ts) AS fin,round(avg(frame_ms),1) AS frame_moyen,round(avg(overlay_ms),1) AS overlay_moyen FROM events WHERE cause='overlay' AND width>=2560 AND bloom=1 AND ts>='2026-09-24T16:00:00.000Z';

Q32_tick_detail.sql: SELECT server_id,event,count(*) AS n,min(local_time) AS debut,max(local_time) AS fin,min(tick_gap_ms) AS gap_min,max(tick_gap_ms) AS gap_max FROM events WHERE tick_gap_ms>=150 GROUP BY server_id,event;

Q33_farming_detail.sql: SELECT substr(local_time,1,10) AS jour,count(*) AS n,min(local_time) AS debut,max(local_time) AS fin,round(min(duration_s),2) AS min_s,round(max(duration_s),2) AS max_s FROM events WHERE short_win=1 GROUP BY jour;

Q34_farming_attribution.sql: SELECT p.client_id,count(*) AS rapports,count(DISTINCT p.server_id) AS parties FROM events p JOIN events g ON p.server_id=g.server_id AND g.short_win=1 WHERE p.event='perf_spike' GROUP BY p.client_id;
